sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Lubber is a term for a helpful fairy of British lore. The heading points the reader to the fuller LOB entry. A lubber is a friendly brownie or field-dwelling spirit. The word also gives the sea term landlubber. See LOB for the full account.
